name: ASM-009 low-profile wireless keyboard assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a generic compact low-profile wireless keyboard with repeated chiclet-style keys, function row, modifier row, arrow cluster, and rear battery ridge.

tasks.prompt: Create a generic low-profile wireless keyboard assembly visually inspired by compact chiclet keyboards, with a slim base tray, repeated keycaps, grouped function row, main alpha/number rows, long spacebar, wide modifier keys, arrow cluster, and small rear/battery ridge. Do not include logos or trademark text.
assumptions: This is a generic keyboard benchmark and does not model proprietary branding, logos, or exact trademarked product details.
Repeated simple keycaps are the core semantic feature; legends are intentionally omitted for robustness and speed.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
